overview.short: Gurdwara Bal Lila Maini Sangat in Patna City marks the historic palace of Raja Fateh Chand Maini, where child Gobind Rai spent his early childhood playing and blessing Rani Maini.
overview.description: Situated just a few hundred paces from Takht Sri Patna Sahib, Gurdwara Bal Lila is a deeply revered Sikh historical sanctuary. Child Gobind Rai (later Guru Gobind Singh Ji) would sit in the lap of childless Rani Maini, who lovingly served him boiled gram (Chhola-Poori). To this day, the unique prasad of boiled spiced chickpeas is served to all visitors from the historic Chulha Sahib hearth.

overview.about: A tender, sacred shrine vibrating with pure childhood devotion, selfless hospitality, and historic seventeenth-century Sikh heritage along the Ganga.

howToReach.roadNote: Located in Patna City on Maini Sangat Lane off Ashok Rajpath and Patna Marine Drive.

routes.byTrain: Local train to Patna Sahib (15 mins)
